text:
sara-partners: Heads up, CloudPartnerX sent a sampled usage export this morning. They report 1/10 sampling in some regions and full counts in others. They want us to auto-scale counts during recon. cc @andrew-platform @leo-finance

andrew-platform: We can support sampling_rate in the mapping. Important: partner must include sampling_rate per-event or per-batch, not just in docs. Without that we can't safely upscale. Also request they include sample_confidence and sample_method (systematic|random).

leo-finance: From finance side we need the upscaled_amount logged alongside raw_count. Reconciliations should surface both and have an adjustments column. Auto-credit rules must be auditable and reversible.

nina-sec: Security: sampling metadata is sensitive only if it identifies users; still require HMAC and hashed customer id. Exchange HMAC via secure channel. Also limit raw payload retention to 180 days by default.

andrew-platform: Proposal for connector behavior: if sampling_rate present -> normalized = raw * sampling_rate. If sampling_rate missing but partner declares sampling in onboarding, mark events as sampled_needs_review and don't auto-scale. Dedup keys: [batch_id,event_id].

taylor-qa: For tests we'll need: a) sampled batch with sampling_rate=10, b) replay of the same batch with same batch_id (should dedup), c) late arrival that falls inside partial-credit window. I can generate CSV expected outputs for the dry-run.

sara-partners: I'll ask partner for 72h samples including one sampled batch per region, plus docs for sample_method. Request HMAC headers and cert thumbprint. ETA EOD Mon.

ops-bot: Created ticket PARTNER-4523: cloudpartnerx sampling + ledger integration. Dry-run scheduled 2026-03-18T08:00Z.

leo-finance: Action items: 1) ledger schema with raw_value, normalized_value, sampling_rate, adjustment_usd 2) export CSV template for finance 3) dispute flow steps. @andrew-platform can you sketch ledger schema?

andrew-platform: Will draft ledger_table schema and PR template today. Will include fields: partner_id, customer_hash, batch_id, event_id, ts, raw_value, sampling_rate, normalized_value, reconcile_run_id, adjustment_reason.

sara-partners: Great. I'll bundle onboarding checklist + example sampled payload and send to CloudPartnerX. Will update this thread when they confirm. :raised_hands:
